  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    Release
    Data structure with metadata information about a release.
    ReleaseChangeEventListener
    A service that receives activation events and can publish these - e.g.
    ReleaseChangeEventPublisher
    Service that distributes ReleaseChangeEvents among the ReleaseChangeEventListeners.
    ReleaseChangeProcess
    A process or workflow that can be triggered by a ReleaseChangeEvent which, for instance, replicates the release into a remote system.
    ReleaseChangeProcess.ReplicationHistoryEntry
    An entry that tells about a historical replication.
    ReleaseMapper
    Controls when a com.composum.sling.platform.staging.StagingResourceResolver applies the release mapping, and when it just passes on the current resources.
    ReleaseNumberCreator
    Strategy to create the key for a release.
    StagingConstants
    Constants related to the staging mechanisms.
    StagingReleaseManager
    Functionality to manage releases that are accessible via the StagingResourceResolver or via replication .
    StagingReleaseManagerPlugin
    A hook into the DefaultStagingReleaseManager.
    VersionReference
    Provides access to the data saved about the activation in a version reference within a release (the StagingConstants.TYPE_VERSIONREFERENCE nodes.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ReleaseChangeEvent
    Information about some activated or deactivated resources in a release, to control replication.

    ReleaseChangeEventPublisher.ReplicationStateInfo
    Information about one ReleaseChangeProcess used for JSON serialization.

  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    ReleaseChangeFailedException
    Informs that a release change failed, and a full site replication is needed.
    StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException
    Is thrown when a user tries to modify a Release.isClosed() release.
    StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseExistsException
    Is thrown when a release label given as argument is not found for a release root.
    StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseNotFoundException
    Is thrown when a release label given as argument is not found for a release root.
    StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseProtectedException
    Is thrown when a release should be deleted that's has Release.getMarks().
    StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseRootNotFoundException
    Is thrown when there is no release root for a versionable.
